title: August and the Echo
author: Elodie Whitlock
blurb: Freya Yarrow, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
